title: ONE
statusNote: The N-Gage 2.0 game by Digital Legends, not the original N-Gage card of the same name. Menus, Versus and a fight in landscape with correct 3D, 24 to 26 fps on a fast laptop. The dump is a community release without signatures, which the N-Gage application refuses, so the player installs the game directly.
notes: Punch and kick start on keys the phone does not have. Rebind them in the game's pause menu (left soft key).
The phone is turned to landscape by the game, 320×240.

controls.source: Watched in play during the bring-up: the menus, Versus and a fight. Punch and kick were not mapped to phone keys by default.

actions.lsk: Pause menu (controls can be rebound there)
